jobs.title: Adobe Workfront Fusion Developer
jobs.description:
Unleash Your Potential at L'Oréal's Beauty Tech!
  
  

Who Are We?
  
  

For 115 years, L’Oréal, the world’s leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world.
  
  

For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted itself solely to one business: Beauty. Present in 150 countries across five continents and with €42 billion consolidated sales, L'Oréal is the global industry leader. With 37 global beauty brands across four divisions, L’Oréal offers beauty for each covering all beauty categories and catering to all beauty desires. With the acquisition of the Australian brand Aēsop in 2023, the Group continues to expand its portfolio through targeted acquisitions as part of its drive to create the future of beauty.
  
  

Today, L’Oréal includes more than 2,000 tech professionals and is constantly growing. Beauty Tech is changing the game and leading the shift towards new consumer realities and a digital disruption. Championing Beauty Tech, we invent the beauty of the future while becoming the company of the future.
  
  

Beauty Tech is how we know our consumers intimately, augmenting their beauty journeys with unparalleled diverse and sustainable experiences. Beauty Tech equips the Group with the key assets it needs to conquer this new world, where Tech has become strategic. With this ambition, L’Oréal continues to recruit diverse, innovative, skilled and passionate minds in different tech domains such as Data, Digital, Cloud, Cyber Security, IT Architecture, DevOps, Applications and Infrastructure.
  
  

A Day in the Life of Adobe Workfront Fusion Developer!
  
  

L'Oreal is deploying Adobe Workfront globally as the core platform for its Content Adaptation Factories. These factories adapt, localise, and deliver marketing assets at scale across all global markets. As a Fusion Developer, you will build and maintain the automated integration workflows that connect Workfront with the broader Content Tech ecosystem — including OpenText DAM, translation engines, and custom APIs. Your work directly impacts speed\-to\-market, asset quality, and operational efficiency across L'Oreal's global brands.
  
  

In this role, You will..
  
  

**Be responsible for the following:**  

* Integration Scenario Design — Architect and build robust, high\-performance integration scenarios in Adobe Workfront Fusion connecting Workfront with DAM, translation/localisation engines, and custom APIs.
* Workflow Automation — Automate complex business processes: auto\-creating project structures for local adaptation based on global campaign signals, automated validation routing, and status synchronisation across systems.
* API Integration \& Data Mapping — Write custom API calls, parse JSON/XML payloads, and handle data transformation between systems of record. Manage authentication flows (OAuth2, JWT, API Keys).
* Monitoring \& Troubleshooting — Proactively monitor active Fusion scenarios, analyse run logs, troubleshoot execution errors, and implement error\-handling mechanisms (automatic retries, alert notifications) to ensure high availability.
* Performance Optimization — Optimize scenarios for high\-volume transaction throughput while respecting API rate limits of connected systems. Implement backoff and concurrency management strategies.
* Technical Documentation — Maintain clear documentation of all Fusion scenarios, data flows, integration mappings, and error\-handling logic.
* Collaborative Solutioning — Partner with Workfront Solution Architects, Business Analysts, and Product Managers to translate business requirements into technical integration specifications.


What are we looking for?
  
  

Adobe Workfront Fusion — Advanced
  
  

* Scenario architecture using Routers, Filters, Convergers, Aggregators (Array, Numeric, Text), and Iterators for complex multi\-layered data structures.

Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. ***There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.***
  

  

  

 At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise\-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive. Over 72,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S\&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks’ customer experience (CX) and employee experience (EX) software to fuel customer loyalty and service efficiency. * Maintain an agile, high\-conviction roadmap capable of fluidly adapting to shifting enterprise priorities, competitive shifts, and technical discoveries without losing strategic momentum.
* Demonstrate bold thought leadership by challenging legacy ITSM paradigms and introducing modern, self\-service, and AI\-first product paradigms.



**2\. Requirements Definition \& Lifecycle Management**



* Lead the end\-to\-end product lifecycle—from initial problem discovery and UX journey mapping to detailed PRDs, roadmap prioritization, and feature rollout.
* Translate complex IT operational workflows, service desk mechanics, and routing logic into exceptionally clear, developer\-ready technical requirements.
* Maintain daily operational execution standards across engineering squads, driving high velocity in a fast\-paced release environment.



**3\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Stakeholder Alignment**



* Partner intimately with UX Design and Engineering to co\-author elegant, accessible solutions tailored for both IT administrators and end\-users.
* Serve as the primary communications bridge across the business, keeping internal partners (Design, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Leadership) and external stakeholders aligned on delivery timelines and strategic value.
* Drive alignment across executive and cross\-functional leadership through transparent, data\-backed product narratives and clear ROI justification.



**4\. Customer Advocacy \& Co\-Creation**



* Partner directly with enterprise IT leaders, sysadmins, and end\-users to prioritize critical pain points, map high\-impact themes, and co\-design solution workflows.
* Cultivate deep user empathy to convert complex service desk friction into intuitive, consumer\-grade product experiences.

* **Ecosystem Fluidity:** 
 A proven ability to rapidly deconstruct, master, and stay ahead of evolving ITSM frameworks, API ecosystems, and modern enterprise IT infrastructure.

 High comfort reprioritizing strategies and roadmaps mid\-cycle in response to new data, technical constraints, or shifting market demands.

* Experience working with Agile methodologies and cross\-functional product delivery teams.

jobs.description:
Cleaned Document
   

  

**About The Role And Team**
 Product at Uber means making big decisions without perfect information\-and owning the outcomes. As a Senior Product Manager (Tech), you will turn massive complexity into clarity at speed, navigating the "messy" reality of multi\-sided marketplaces and high\-stakes technical integrations. You will be at the heart of our most ambitious missions, architecting solutions that bridge the digital and physical worlds for millions of users globally.
   

  

 This is a high\-visibility, high\-impact role where you won't just manage a roadmap; you will build 0\-to\-1 platforms that bridge the digital and physical worlds. You'll need to lead through influence, not control, and stay resilient while balancing the needs of external partners, engineering teams, and global business units. If you are a curious, owner\-minded product leader who is energized by challenge and motivated by real\-world impact\-this is where you'll grow.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Build a bold product vision and strategy for your domain, identifying near and long\-term initiatives that unlock the next wave of Uber's global growth.
* Design and ship scalable technology solutions\-including APIs, orchestration layers, and developer tools\-to deeply interpret and respond to complex marketplace signals.
* Navigate and align cross\-functional teams across Engineering, Data Science, Design, and Legal to drive cohesive product strategies despite competing priorities.
* Translate unstructured user pain points into clear product requirements by distilling complex problems, writing hypotheses, and defining measurable outcomes.
* Forge and manage strategic relationships with external partners, fintechs, or autonomous technology providers to scale deployments and optimize global operations.

 As a Senior Product Associate in Digital Acquisition and Enablement Platforms, you contribute to the team by leveraging your expertise in product development and optimization to make a significant impact, supported by user research and customer feedback to fuel the creation of innovative products and continuously improve existing offerings. Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams and play a crucial role in shaping the future of our products and ongoing success.

Positive attitude and easy to work with while delivering on high priority, time sensitive initiatives
* Expertise in site reliability engineering practices
* Expertise in continuous integration/continuous delivery methodologies and in automated testing integrated within a development pipeline
* Experience in delivery of engineering best practices and solutions across a large product group
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* In\-depth knowledge of Agile process and principles, including use of Agile project management tools (i.e., Confluence, JIRA/JIRA Align, etc.)


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Demonstrated prior experience working in a highly matrixed, complex organization
* Expertise in observability such as white and black box monitoring, SLO alerting, and telemetry collection using tools such as Grafana, Dynatrace, Datadog, Splunk, etc.
* Expertise with automated testing including, but not limited to, unit, component, contract, end to end, and production testing
* Demonstrated experience with AI tools

Morgan and Chase brands.  We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success.  Our Consumer \& Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most\-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

The Senior Risk \& Compliance Specialist III (SME) is responsible for managing complex and high\-risk Identity operations while serving as a subject matter expert for assigned workflows. Beyond case execution, this role drives operational excellence through quality oversight, data\-driven insights, knowledge management, and continuous process improvement.  

The ideal candidate combines strong investigative judgment with analytical thinking and is passionate about improving both operational quality and the overall user experience.  

  

**What you'll do*** **Operational Excellence**  

Review and resolve complex, ambiguous, high\-risk, and regulatory\-sensitive Identity cases.  

Serve as the escalation point for frontline teams and internal stakeholders on assigned workflows.  

Perform quality reviews and provide actionable feedback to improve operational consistency and decision quality.  

Ensure compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and operational standards.
* **Subject Matter Expertise**  

Act as the designated SME for specific Identity workflows or Lines of Business.  

Partner with Program, Policy, and Operations teams to provide workflow expertise and operational guidance.  

Support launches, process changes, and operational readiness for new capabilities.
* **Data, Insights \& Continuous Improvement**  

Analyze quality trends, operational metrics, and compliance outcomes to identify improvement opportunities.  

Generate structured insights from audits and quality reviews to influence product, policy, and process enhancements.  

Support automation and efficiency initiatives through data analysis and operational recommendations.  

Build recurring reporting and dashboards that improve visibility into operational health and quality performance.
* **Knowledge Management**  

Maintain and update knowledge base articles, SOPs, and training materials to reflect policy or regulatory changes.  

Partner with Training and Quality teams to ensure documentation remains accurate and scalable.  

Identify recurring knowledge gaps and recommend improvements to operational documentation.
* **Operational Excellence \& Capability Building**  

Drive initiatives that improve BPO quality through structured reporting, insights, and root cause analysis.  

Recommend scalable solutions that improve operational efficiency, reduce defects, and strengthen compliance.  

Contribute to projects that enhance the effectiveness and maturity of Identity Operations.

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to interpret operational data and identify trends.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex investigations and make sound decisions in ambiguous situations.
* Experience working cross\-functionally with multiple stakeholders.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace or Microsoft Office tools.

* Source new products and run the purchase\-order process end\-to\-end, from requisition to PO issue and confirmation.
* Uphold PO accuracy and meet creation, amendment and urgent\-order turnaround targets, since errors here ripple into receiving and invoicing.

* Process urgent or exception\-driven manual requisitions in the procurement platform. Apply strict system tracking tags in external reference fields to preserve downstream automated three\-way matching and prevent invoicing holds.

* Manage Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) workflows directly with suppliers to resolve damaged or incorrect deliveries.

* Manage the asset lifecycle — creating part numbers, assigning assets and keeping records updated through moves, reassignments and retirements.

* Validate prepayment terms against threshold criteria and coordinate internal cost\-reallocation (chargeback) ledgers.

* New Product Introduction (NPI) Support
* Track NPI requests through the pipeline, submit RFQs to suppliers and create the system IDs needed to transact new products.
* Coordinate with catalog and engineering teams during product launches to set up the correct Base\-and\-Variant MID hierarchy, establishing regional variant entries under active parent items.
* Facilitate international shipments by initiating part compliance steps (New Part Requests, trade classifications, and customs valuations) in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) tools, ensuring parts are pre\-cleared before transit.

* PR / PO Creation Turnaround: create ≥95% of standard requisitions within 2 business days of a complete, approved request.
* Urgent PR / PO Creation: create ≥99% of urgent requisitions within 4 hours, so time\-critical needs are not held up.
* PR / PO Amendment \& Change Orders: process ≥95% of amendments within 1 business day, and communicate approved PO changes within ≤2 days.
* Maintain a triage SLA of 3 hours to acknowledge new procurement requests.
* Maintain ≥99% data accuracy on all hardware, pricing, and tax classification fields.
* Documentation Completeness \& Knowledge Management: keep a current directory of process documentation with revision dates and contribute to the shared knowledge base, so SOPs stay accurate and reusable.
* Perform follow\-up actions and update statuses on all open catalog or exception tickets every 3 days.

jobs.title: Business Analyst - Project Financial Management
jobs.description:
**Working with Us**  

Challenging. Meaningful. Life\-changing. Those aren’t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. Here, uniquely interesting work happens every day, in every department. From optimizing a production line to the latest breakthroughs in cell therapy, this is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. You’ll get the chance to grow and thrive through opportunities uncommon in scale and scope, alongside high\-achieving teams. Take your career farther than you thought possible.


Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives. Read more: careers.bms.com/working\-with\-us .


**Key Responsibilities**
========================

### **Project Financial Management**

* Partner with project teams to develop, monitor, and maintain project budgets, forecasts, and financial plans.
* Analyze project actuals, commitments, accruals, and forecast variances.
* Identify financial risks, gaps, and corrective actions to ensure projects remain within approved budgets.
* Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial planning and forecasting activities.
* Track project spend against approved funding and provide recommendations to improve financial performance.

### **Financial Analysis \& Reporting**

* Prepare financial reports, dashboards, and analysis for project and portfolio stakeholders.
* Perform detailed variance analysis and explain key financial trends.
* Maintain financial data integrity within ERP and Project Portfolio Management systems.
* Support leadership reporting through development of accurate and timely financial insights.
* Assist in financial modeling and scenario analysis activities.

### **Governance \& Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to Project Financial Management standards, processes, and controls.
* Support project audits, financial reviews, and governance activities.
* Maintain project financial documentation and supporting records.
* Assist with project capitalization, procurement, and financial compliance activities.
* Drive issue identification and resolution for project financial concerns.

### **Procurement \& Vendor Financial Support**

* Coordinate creation and maintenance of Purchase Orders.
* Monitor vendor spending and financial commitments.
* Support invoice reconciliation and financial tracking activities.
* Partner with Procurement and Finance teams to ensure timely processing of project expenditures.

### **AI, Analytics \& Automation**

* Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting and financial management activities.
* Leverage Generative AI tools to improve reporting, variance analysis, forecasting, and documentation quality.
* Develop AI\-assisted dashboards and insights to improve project financial transparency.
* Utilize automation platforms such as Power Automate, Automation Anywhere, or similar tools to improve operational efficiency.
* Support implementation of AI and automation initiatives across project financial processes.

### **Process Improvement**

* Document project financial processes and recommend enhancements.
* Implement best practices that improve financial governance, reporting consistency, and operational efficiency.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on financial operations and project delivery excellence.
* Support optimization of ServiceNow PPM and financial management workflows.

### **Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Partner effectively with project managers, PMOs, Finance, Procurement, and business stakeholders.
* Communicate financial information to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Provide guidance and support on project financial processes and reporting requirements.
* Contribute to cross\-functional initiatives and project governance activities.

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Information Systems, or related field.
* 4–7 years of experience in Project Financial Management, Financial Analysis, PMO Operations, or related disciplines.
* Experience supporting medium to large\-scale technology or business transformation projects.
* Experience working within matrixed global organizations.

**Financial \& Business Skills**

* Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, accruals, financial reporting, and variance analysis.
* Knowledge of project lifecycle financial management.
* Understanding of procurement processes and Purchase Order management.
* Ability to analyze large datasets and identify meaningful insights.

**Technical Skills**

* Intermediate to advanced experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Workday Financials, or similar).
* Experience using Project Portfolio Management tools (ServiceNow PPM, Planview, MS Project, or equivalent).
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including Pivot Tables, Power Query, and financial modeling.
* Strong PowerPoint and data visualization capabilities.
* Experience with Power BI or similar analytics platforms.

**AI \& Automation Skills**

* Experience using Generative AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise, or similar platforms.
* Understanding of prompt engineering and AI\-assisted business processes.
* Knowledge of workflow automation tools such as Power Automate, Automation Anywhere, or UiPath.

jobs.title: Business Systems Analyst (Data & Integration)
jobs.description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**
 We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
   

  

 We use cutting\-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience.

**Summary:**
 The Business Systems Analyst \- Data \& Integrations plays a crucial role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. This role involves gathering, analysing, and documenting business requirements, and working closely with stakeholders to ensure that the solutions meet the business objectives. Being in our data \& integrations function, you will play a critical role in supporting and enabling our data warehousing, system integrations and reporting

Understanding the different insights needed for different business areas.

* Work with internal and external stakeholders to pull data together from multiple sources, to gain deeper insights, and guide them to “put data first” to improve our analytical capabilities.

**Challenge:**

**Documentation**

**Testing and Validation**
* Assist in the development of test cases and testing procedures for new or updated reports and their data.

* Help prioritise system requirements based on business needs, resource availability, and the potential business impact.

* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment is preferred.
* Data analytics certification is preferred
* Strong analytical, mathematical and problem\-solving skills


 Excellent English verbal and written communication skills.
   

  

**Why join us?**
 We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space \- and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game\-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.
   

  

**An inclusive environment to thrive**
 We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles \- not just on key days, but every day.
   

  

**Be rewarded for your efforts**
 We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.
   

  

 Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.

* You with Order system \-SAP \& B2C or SAP knowledge would be preferred.

* 4 years of experience in a role preparing and delivering technical presentations to executive leadership.
* A strong interest or background in AI/ML product management.
* Strong data analysis skills coupled with deep user empathy and a natural curiosity about data.

**About the job**
-----------------


At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  

  

In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  

  

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  


User Generated Content (UGC) covers a wide range of products that enable Google Maps (Geo) users to share their real\-world experiences and facts of the world with others in the form of reviews/ratings on businesses, photos or videos, asking and answering questions about a place, place attributes, etc. It is a critical determinant of success for businesses and a key enabler for user decision\-making. Fraud and abuse take many forms across the platform and are designed to manipulate consumer decision making or make the platform unsafe for users and businesses ranging from gaming business ratings and posting fraudulent phone numbers to uploading offensive media and vandalizing the map for personal motives.

  

The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives.  

  

The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Define the product goal, roadmap, and success metrics, using data analysis and evaluation to inform both high\-level strategy and day\-to\-day decisions.
* Provide cross\-functional leadership to a virtual team spanning engineering, operations, analytics, UX, policy, legal, PR, privacy, and compliance across multiple product areas (Geo, Core, Trust and Safety, Commerce).
* Be resourceful in rallying stakeholders behind a common goal, backed by articulate and confident communication.
* Collaborate effectively with machine learning, platform, and experiences teams to build scalable solutions.
* Work in a fast\-paced, high\-visibility environment working alongside with technical teams including AI/ML.

jobs.title: Product Manager : Consumer Experience
jobs.description:
**Product Manager : Consumer Experience** 




  





**We’re looking for a Product Manager who turns customer understanding into shipped outcomes.** 




 MyYogaTeacher helps people across the world improve their health and well being through live, personalized yoga. We connect students with experienced yoga teachers in India for 1\-on\-1 sessions designed around their goals, lifestyle, health conditions, and preferences.
 



 Our platform has served 200K\+ customers and supports thousands of live sessions across time zones, devices, payment systems, and customer journeys.
 



 We are now entering a phase where speed, clarity, and execution matter more than ever.
 



 We are looking for a hands\-on Product Manager who can speak with students, understand their real motivations, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and work closely with design, engineering, analytics, sales, and operations to ship meaningful improvements quickly.
 



 This is not a role for someone who only writes requirements, manages Jira, or waits for complete data before making a decision.
 



 You will be expected to understand the customer, form a point of view, bring teams together, and drive the product from problem discovery through execution and measurable impact.
 



  





**What You’ll Own** 




**Customer and Persona Understanding** 



* Develop a deep understanding of our students—their goals, anxieties, motivations, objections, habits, and reasons for choosing personalized yoga.
* Regularly speak with prospective students, active customers, churned customers, teachers, sales teams, and customer support teams.
* Convert customer conversations, behavioral data, support tickets, sales calls, and session feedback into clear product insights.
* Build and continuously refine customer personas and journey maps based on evidence rather than assumptions.
* Understand the underlying job the customer is hiring MyYogaTeacher to do—not merely the feature they are requesting.
* Ensure that product decisions remain connected to why MyYogaTeacher exists: helping people build healthier, happier, and more sustainable lives and identify ambivalence.



  





**Product Discovery and Decision Making** 



* Identify high impact opportunities across acquisition, trial, conversion, onboarding, engagement, retention, referrals, and reactivation.
* Clearly define the customer problem, target persona, expected behavior change, and desired business outcome before proposing a solution.
* Form strong product hypotheses using qualitative insights, product analytics, market understanding, and business context.
* Make thoughtful decisions even when information is incomplete or circumstances are changing.
* Distinguish between decisions that require deeper research and decisions that can be made quickly and reversed later.
* Maintain a clear product decision log so teams understand what was decided, why it was decided, and what assumptions are being tested.
* Challenge weak assumptions, unnecessary complexity, and solutions that do not address the underlying customer problem.



  





**Execution and Delivery** 



* Take end to end ownership of product initiatives from problem discovery to launch, adoption, measurement, and iteration.
* Translate product opportunities into clear requirements, user journeys, success metrics, edge cases, and acceptance criteria.
* Work closely with design and engineering to reduce ambiguity and unblock decisions quickly.
* Break large initiatives into smaller releases that allow the team to learn and deliver customer value sooner.
* Participate actively throughout development instead of handing over requirements and waiting for completion.
* Review product builds continuously, identify gaps early, and ensure that the final experience solves the intended problem.
* Drive weekly execution across multiple product initiatives while maintaining clarity on priorities and outcomes.
* Follow through after launch to measure adoption, identify friction, and improve the product based on actual customer behavior.



  





**Product Analytics and Business Impact** 



* Define measurable outcomes for every major product initiative.
* Use funnel analysis, cohort analysis, customer segmentation, experiment results, and qualitative feedback to understand product performance.
* Monitor key metrics across trial completion, trial\-to\-paid conversion, onboarding, session attendance, engagement, retention, referrals, and customer satisfaction.
* Investigate unexpected changes in customer behavior instead of relying only on dashboard\-level reporting.
* Partner with analytics and engineering teams to improve the quality and usefulness of product data.
* Communicate whether a product initiative worked, what was learned, and what should happen next.



  





**Cross\-Functional Leadership** 



* Bring together engineering, design, analytics, sales, marketing, teacher operations, and customer support around a shared understanding of the customer problem.
* Communicate product decisions clearly and directly across technical and non\-technical teams.
* Resolve ambiguity and disagreements by returning the discussion to customer evidence, strategic priorities, and expected outcomes.
* Conduct product demonstrations and training for teams responsible for launching, selling, supporting, or operating new experiences.
* Ensure that teams understand not only what is being built, but why it matters.
* Take accountability for the outcome without blaming dependencies, processes, or other functions when execution becomes difficult.



  





**AI\-First Product Management** 



* Use AI tools as part of your daily product workflow—not as an occasional experiment.
* Apply AI to accelerate customer research synthesis, product analysis, competitive research, requirement development, prototyping, test\-case thinking, and documentation.
* Use AI to explore more alternatives and move faster while continuing to apply…

 Product Manager / Product Manager \- II
 



**Experience Required:** 
 3\-5 years
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru, KR
 



  





**The Role** 




 We're hiring Product Managers to own product lines within our LOS platform — end to end. You'll gather requirements directly with credit union clients, write stories, run sprints with your engineering pod, coordinate vendor integrations, and ship features that go live for real users.
 



 Beyond product lines, you'll own client implementations. Each PM on the team takes a credit union implementation end to end — from requirement gathering through go\-live. We rotate implementations across the team so everyone builds the muscle of running a full client delivery, not just a feature backlog.
 



 You'll also contribute to the overall platform roadmap — identifying patterns across client implementations, surfacing what should be configurable vs. custom, and shaping the product into something that scales beyond any single client.
 



 This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role. You won't be writing strategy decks. You'll be in the details — on client calls understanding how an underwriter makes decisions, in vendor docs figuring out an API spec, in sprint planning making scope tradeoffs with your engineers.
 



  





**A typical week looks like** 



* 2\-3 client calls with US credit union stakeholders — CXOs, managers, underwriters,
* Act as the bridge between US team \& India Engineering team
* Writing PRFAQs, stories and acceptance criteria for upcoming work
* Sprint ceremonies with your engineering pod — planning, grooming, retro
* Coordinating with 2\-3 vendor integration teams — API specs, test data, certification
* Ensuring alignment across organisation for delivery for your product line \& client implementation



  





**What you'll ship in the first 6 months** 



* Own a product line end\-to\-end
* Own a client implementation from requirements through go\-live
* Ship features that go live in production for real credit union users
* Manage 3\-5 vendor integrations through to QA sign\-off
* Run your pod's sprint cycle independently
* Contribute at least one platform\-level improvement that benefits all clients



  





**What we're looking for** 



* Biased for action, grounded in first principles — you ship fast, but you think before you build.
* AI\-native — you use AI tools daily to multiply your output, not as a novelty. You write specs faster, research deeper, and make better decisions because AI is part of how you work.
* Comfortable working directly with clients (US business hours overlap required — expect 2\-3 late evening calls per week)
* Writes clearly — PRFAQs, story documents, acceptance criteria
* Can own an engineering pod's backlog — sprint planning, grooming, prioritization
* Understands lending workflows — origination, decisioning, underwriting, funding
* Can navigate vendor integrations — read API docs, coordinate with external teams, unblock engineers
* Uses data and judgment to make scope calls fast — you won't have perfect information
* Takes feedback well and gives it directly



  





**Qualifications** 




**Required:** 



* 3\-5 years total experience with at least 2 years in product management
* Lending, banking, or fintech domain experience
* Experience working with engineering teams in an agile environment
* Actively uses AI tools in daily PM work — research, writing, analysis, decision\-making
* Familiar with Claude Code to leverage AI \& work at 10x productivity
* BTech/BE. MBA preferred.



  





**Preferred / Bonus:** 



* **Familiar with Claude Code to leverage AI \& work at 10x productivity**
* US lending industry experience
* US indirect auto lending (dealer\-lender workflows, RouteOne, DealerTrack)
* US home equity / HELOC product experience
* Credit union operations experience
* Experience with loan origination systems (any vendor)
* Familiarity with core banking integrations (Jack Henry, Fiserv, Corelation)
* Familiarity with credit bureau data (TransUnion, Equifax, Experian)
* Experience with decision engines or business rules platforms

This position will support the production and oversight process for SEC Form N\-PORT and N\-CEN filings. **Title:** 
 Product Owner Data and Integrations
   

  

**Location** 
 : Bangalore/Pune, India
   

  

**Overview:** 
 Johnson Controls is seeking an experienced and business\-focused Product Owner to lead the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of data and integrations teams for an enterprise eCommerce application. This role will serve as the bridge between business stakeholders, technology teams, data engineering, architecture, and external partners to translate business needs into scalable data flows, APIs, integration requirements, and prioritized product backlogs. The Product Owner will drive outcomes that improve data quality, system interoperability, operational efficiency, and user adoption while ensuring solutions meet security, governance, performance, and compliance expectations. The role requires techno\-functional skills to analyze data, write SQLs, create and update field mappings, and debug issues with cross\-platform teams.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own and maintain the product vision, roadmap, and prioritized backlog for data and integrations teams.
* Be the SME for APIs, and data process flows.
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand objectives, pain points, reporting needs, process gaps, and integration requirements, translating them into clear user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with data engineering, application development, architecture, security, and QA teams to design and deliver scalable, reliable, and secure data and integration solutions.
* Ensure data quality, lineage, governance, privacy, and compliance considerations are embedded into product requirements and delivery decisions.
* Manage sprint planning, backlog refinement, release planning, demos, and stakeholder reviews in alignment with Agile delivery practices.
* Evaluate technical feasibility, business value, risk, and dependency impacts when prioritizing features, enhancements, defects, and technical debt.
* Work with teams to establish performance, reliability, monitoring, and support expectations for data pipelines, APIs, and integration services.
* Support user acceptance testing by validating that delivered capabilities meet business objectives, functional requirements, and defined acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate cross\-functional dependencies across internal teams, external vendors, and enterprise platforms to ensure successful end\-to\-end delivery.
* Communicate product status, roadmap priorities, delivery risks, decisions, and outcomes clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
* Drive adoption and continuous improvement by gathering feedback, monitoring usage, measuring product success, and identifying opportunities to enhance data and integration capabilities.


**Qualifications**
* 6\-8 years of experience in product ownership, business analysis, solution delivery, data platforms, integrations, or enterprise application delivery.
* Demonstrated experience defining product roadmaps, managing backlogs, writing user stories, and prioritizing work based on business value, technical feasibility, and stakeholder impact.
* Functional understanding of APIs and data integration concepts, including APIs, ETL/ELT, data pipelines, batch and real\-time processing, data mapping, and system interoperability.
* Experience working with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, ERP, CRM, data warehouses, data lakes, middleware, iPaaS, or integration platforms.
* Ability to translate complex business processes and data needs into clear functional and technical requirements for engineering and delivery teams.
* Familiarity with data governance, data quality, data privacy, master data management, lineage, security, and compliance considerations.
* Experience working in Agile Scrum teams, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, demos, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with business users, technical teams, vendors, architects, QA teams, and leadership.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain data and integration concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Analytical mindset with strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to balance strategic product direction with day\-to\-day delivery decisions.
* Experience with product management and delivery tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms.
* Knowledge of cloud data platforms, API management, event streaming, middleware, or modern integration architecture is preferred.
* Relevant certifications such as Certified Scrum Product Owner, SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, Salesforce, cloud, data, or integration certifications are preferred.
